name: @amamo/doctrine
description: An MDX-first static documentation site generator
author: 白熱 <sonne@asaki.me>

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('src/runtime/styles.css', 'dist/runtime/styles.css')"
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js dev docs
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js build docs --site-url https://jikkai.github.io/doctrine/
